(1) the banking sector in Russia fosters innovation activity; (2) the impact of banking development on innovation is stronger for small enterprises; (3) the impact of financial development on innovations is stronger for incremental innovations; (4) the impact of bank development on innovations is higher for firms with low R&D intensity; (5) the impact of banks on innovation is higher for firms which do not have access to stock market
